- Usually user/account deactivation ticket requests have already the information on how they want the account to be closed and who should have access to emails and/or user data moving forward. Confirm with user if other details are needed (like if the license should be kept in the pool for future use).
- Once we have all the information needed (user account, effective date, email forwarding, OOO, etc.) we can proceed with the account termination.
On 365 Admin (sign in with csupport@earlgreygolfclub.com), kick user from all active sessions and block direct logins.
On AD (EGR-PDC2022) change account password (WE DO NOT DELETE ACCOUNT) and run sync script (Start-ADSyncSyncCycle -PolicyType Delta).
On 365 Exchange Admin, always convert to shared mailbox first then remove license.
Configure email forwarding or delegate access to mailbox if requested.
